supplementalBreakdowns.title: South Carolina FY2024 DHHS cash expenditures by accounting category
supplementalBreakdowns.basis: South Carolina's Comptroller General publishes all 12 FY2024 monthly transaction files from the state's central accounting system. Business area J020, Department of Health and Human Services, nets to $11.145951518B. Directly related Medicaid-recovery accounts are netted against taxable and non-taxable medical services; every other account above $10M is shown separately and 143 smaller accounts form the exact residual. This agency cash-transaction view is supplemental—not additive—to Census's broader public-welfare function or federal-fiscal-year CMS-64 reporting.
